operations.description: Returns aggregate information about the resources protected by the given Cloud KMS CryptoKey. Only resources within the same Cloud organization as the key will be returned. The project that holds the key must be part of an organization in order for this call to succeed.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] kmsinventory projects locations key rings crypto keys protected resources summary [PATH] protected resources summary [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] cloud google inventory kms protected resources summary

operations.description: Returns cryptographic keys managed by Cloud KMS in a given Cloud project. Note that this data is sourced from snapshots, meaning it may not completely reflect the actual state of key metadata at call time.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] kmsinventory projects crypto keys list [PATH] crypto keys [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth page parent pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] cloud crypto google inventory key keys kms list response template version

operations.description: Returns metadata about the resources protected by the given Cloud KMS CryptoKey in the given Cloud organization.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] kmsinventory organizations protected resources search [PATH] protected resources search [PARAMS] access alt callback crypto fields key oauth page pretty print protocol quota resource scope size token type types upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] cloud google inventory kms protected resource resources response search
